title: Vitamin E Mitigates Apoptosis in Ovarian Granulosa Cells by Inhibiting Zearalenone-Induced Activation of the PERK/eIF-2alpha/ATF4/Chop Signaling Pathway.
authors: Liu, Qingxiu; Wang, Leli; An, Lei; Liu, Yafei; Qu, Honglei; Huang, Shimeng; Zhao, Lihong; Yin, Yulong; Ma, Qiugang
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究维生素E缓解玉米赤霉烯酮诱导的卵巢颗粒细胞凋亡，涉及PERK信号通路和分子对接，但核心是细胞凋亡与生殖毒性，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: A study aimed to investigate the signaling pathway of zearalenone (ZEA) leading to the apoptosis of ovarian granulosa cells (GCs) and explore the potential of vitamin E (VE) in alleviating ZEA-induced apoptosis of GCs. We constructed an apoptosis model for GCs based on exposure to the environmental toxin ZEA. Transcriptome analysis revealed that ZEA induced endoplasmic reticulum stress by activating the ATF4-Chop pathway. The addition of inhibitors targeting the estrogen receptor (ER) demonstrated that ZEA activates the ATF4-Chop pathway through ER-beta. As a strong antioxidant, VE is thought to mitigate ZEA-induced toxicity. Interestingly, molecular docking analysis at the PERK active site of the endoplasmic reticulum stress revealed a high binding capacity of VE. VE supplementation reduced apoptosis in GCs and decreased the expression of p-eIF-2alpha, ATF4, and Chop. Mouse tests also demonstrated that VE supplementation effectively mitigated ovarian dysfunction induced by ZEA, as evidenced by increased body weight gain, reduced oxidative stress, and decreased cell death. In summary, the present study demonstrates that ZEA activates the PERK-eIF-2alpha-ATF4-Chop pathway through ERbeta, leading to endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis of GCs. Conversely, VE inhibits the PERK/eIF-2alpha/ATF4/Chop signaling pathways, mitigating endoplasmic reticulum stress and improving ZEA-induced reproductive toxicity.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨玉米赤霉烯酮（ZEA）导致卵巢颗粒细胞（GCs）凋亡的信号通路，并探索维生素E（VE）在缓解ZEA诱导的GCs凋亡中的潜力。我们基于环境毒素ZEA暴露构建了GCs凋亡模型。转录组分析揭示，ZEA通过激活ATF4-Chop通路诱导内质网应激。添加靶向雌激素受体（ER）的抑制剂表明，ZEA通过ER-beta激活ATF4-Chop通路。作为一种强抗氧化剂，VE被认为能减轻ZEA诱导的毒性。有趣的是，在内质网应激的PERK活性位点进行的分子对接分析显示，VE具有高结合能力。补充VE减少了GCs的凋亡，并降低了p-eIF-2alpha、ATF4和Chop的表达。小鼠实验也证明，补充VE有效缓解了ZEA诱导的卵巢功能障碍，表现为体重增加、氧化应激减少和细胞死亡降低。总之，本研究证明ZEA通过ERbeta激活PERK-eIF-2alpha-ATF4-Chop通路，导致内质网应激和GCs凋亡。相反，VE抑制PERK/eIF-2alpha/ATF4/Chop信号通路，减轻内质网应激并改善ZEA诱导的生殖毒性。
